name: Don Diablo
description: Though he may be one of the most notable champions of future house, Don Diablo’s repertoire extends far beyond that, as the launch of his CONTROL ALT DΞLΞTΞ drum & bass alias proved. This year also saw the release of his big ‘5 Minutes’ single, and a 19-track compilation of existing and reworked songs, ‘VΞRSIONS’, featuring collabs with Jamiroquai, Major Lazer, Nelly Furtado and more. He then divided the rest of 2026 between unleashing a series of high-intensity, day-glo festival stormers with the likes of Pink Sweat$, Bipolar Sunshine, Becky G, and A$AP Ferg, and playing a succession of huge shows worldwide.
best_known_for: “Blurring the lines between old school and new school, while building worlds that connect music, art, fashion and technology. Pushing house music into the future.”
